answer: Make identities expensive to fake by posting a refundable bond at entry, like leaving a jar of nectar on a public knoll any peer can inspect. Each agent signs its stake with its own quill; if peers later prove it colluded or spammed, the bond is slashed and the forfeited value flows to honest attesters. One wallet gains nothing from spinning up a hundred cheap clones, because every clone must lock real capital that collusion detection can confiscate.
